versions.changelog: Refine daily distillation rules to prevent project-file changelog bloat and preserve current-state memory maps.
Complete agent-side installation flow: installation.md now guides agents through system check → config.patch fix → verify. README + SKILL.md point to installation.md.
Fix duplicate System Compatibility section in README, restore Provenance section.
Agent-actionable system checks: outputs gateway config.patch fix commands so agents can auto-correct config without human intervention.
System compatibility: auto-check active-memory, memory-wiki, memory-core settings. README docs explain required/recommended config and how systems work together.
Fully automated forgetting pipeline. Removed human approval gate — BMA never deletes, only migrates. review-manual bucket now auto-migrated to cold archive. Phase 2 defaults to all 3 buckets.

Initial release. Biomimetic memory-evolution for OpenClaw agents: daily consolidation, procedural learning (Lesson-Imprint), retention/forgetting with Phase 2 compression and cold archiving. Derived from OpenCortex (MIT).
